stations.title: Old server
stations.text: One function, an if for every address.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Hesper wants the order server moved over by Saturday.
Today every request still goes through Sefton's chain of ifs, which nobody dares touch.
You add groups, a real server and every route of the shop, in three tasks.
Now the order page talks to your router on a real address, staff pages behind their key.
From a table of routes to the shop's whole server, and every line of it explained.
